profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer, .NET engineering manager at Ticketmaster
profile.summary:
Experienced .NET Principal Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of team building and creating numerous revenue generating solutions while under pressure. Also, the master in helping to keep his teammates sane with a quick, snarky joke. 

While working with Ticketmaster, I've been fortunate to work on numerous high visibility projects that helped to generate large amounts of revenue for the TM Resale business. I think of myself as being an excellent mover of data from point A to Z. My team and I have implemented numerous solutions to do this. These solutions include public facing ASP.NET WCF/Web API RESTful APIs, backend .NET applications, SQL Server-based solutions, and some front end ASP.NET MVC web applications. We heavily use numerous open-source enterprise solutions such as Kafka topics, RabbitMQ, Elastic Search and Redis DB. We’re able to leverage these enterprise solutions throughout the many solutions that we build.

I currently manage a team of six engineers (two QA and four developers). I actively code daily, but my focus is to mentor my teammates to ensure their continued development. This directly correlates to their continued ability to provide timely and accurate solutions for Ticketmaster and our external clients.

positions.title: Lead .NET Application Developer
positions.description:
Using VB.NET, C#, XML, ASP.NET, MVC, RESTful Web API web services, SOAP Services, WCF Services, Crystal Reports and SQL Server, my team and I were able to quickly design, code and implement custom, long-standing solutions for the Manufacturing Applications group.

Led a small .NET development team on the redesign and support of the DataMerge Press and Bindery application suite of tools. These applications gather and report upon numerous manufacturing data points from the various presses and bindery lines throughout the RRD enterprise. 

I take great pride in establishing solid, core frameworks and APIs that can be reused by our development teams so that all team members can easily transition between internal projects. I am also responsible for making sure that our developers keep their skills up to date so that we can provide the best possible experiences for our enterprise users.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description: Consulted on several IT projects across different industries. Primarily worked with Visual Basic, SQL Server and Crystal Reports.

positions.title: Army Ranger - Machine Gun Team Leader / Squad M203 Grenadier
positions.description: Worked various infantry platoon positions while serving with 1st Battalion / 75th Ranger Regiment. Stationed at Hunter Army Airfield, Savannah, GA.
